question: Q2 minimum investment plan for F&B (restaurant/cafe), incl. the reported IDR 10bn per KBLI per location rule  [DEAL-BREAKER vs CHF 200k frame]
finding: General rule: PMA total investment must exceed IDR 10bn excluding land and building, per 5-digit KBLI per project location. For food-and-beverage services (KBLI 56) the exception makes it IDR 10bn excluding land and building per 2-digit KBLI per one location point, where a location point means per kabupaten/kota. So the rule applies to restaurants and cafes; it is not a per-outlet rule but a per-city, per-KBLI-56-group rule (analysis: 56101 and 56303 would share one threshold in the same city). No single-outlet relief, phasing or reduced regime found in Art. 26-27.

question: Q2 what counts toward the investment plan and how it is checked
finding: For a PMA, OSS validates the planned investment value against the minimum. The plan must cover at least land purchase, buildings, machinery/equipment, other investment (vehicles, office equipment, feasibility study, permits, pre-opening operating costs during construction) and working capital for one turnover (raw materials, wages, building rent, operating costs until ready to operate). The IDR 10bn test excludes land and building (Art. 26).
